title.zh: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈
title.en: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈

current_state.zh: 特朗普与Meta、Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Palantir、Nvidia等科技公司高管会面讨论AI治理，并签署了一份具有「道德约束力」的AI文件；政府正考虑成立约10人的AI监督委员会；特朗普宣布将AI改名为「超级智能」（SI）。
current_state.en: Trump met with executives from Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Palantir and Nvidia to discuss AI governance and signed a 'morally binding' AI document; the government is considering an approximately 10-person AI oversight committee; Trump announced renaming AI as 'Super Intelligence' (SI).

updates.title_zh: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈
updates.title_en: 特朗普召集6家AI巨头吃午餐：AI该不该踩刹车，白宫当面谈
updates.what_changed_zh: 特朗普与众议院议长迈克·约翰逊在白宫设午宴，与Meta、Anthropic、OpenAI、谷歌、Palantir和英伟达的CEO们共进午餐，讨论AI创新与政府监管之间的平衡，约翰逊拒绝暂停AI发展，但支持提高透明度和加强部分监管。
updates.what_changed_en: Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson hosted a White House lunch with the CEOs of Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Palantir and Nvidia to debate the balance between AI innovation and government oversight, with Johnson rejecting a pause on AI development but backing greater transparency and some supervision.
updates.current_state_zh: 特朗普与众议院议长迈克·约翰逊在白宫设午宴，与Meta、Anthropic、OpenAI、谷歌、Palantir和英伟达的CEO们共进午餐，讨论AI创新与政府监管之间的平衡，约翰逊拒绝暂停AI发展，但支持提高透明度和加强部分监管。
updates.current_state_en: Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson hosted a White House lunch with the CEOs of Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Palantir and Nvidia to debate the balance between AI innovation and government oversight, with Johnson rejecting a pause on AI development but backing greater transparency and some supervision.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson hosted a White House lunch with the CEOs of Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Palantir and Nvidia to debate the balance between AI innovation and government oversight, with Johnson rejecting a pause on AI development but backing greater transparency and some supervision.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson hosted a White House lunch with the CEOs of Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Palantir and Nvidia to debate the balance between AI innovation and government oversight, with Johnson rejecting a pause on AI development but backing greater transparency and some supervision.

updates.title_zh: 特朗普签署「具有道德约束力」的人工智能文件，还改名AI为SI
updates.title_en: 特朗普签署「具有道德约束力」的人工智能文件，还改名AI为SI
updates.what_changed_zh: 特朗普与多家科技公司高管签署了一份与人工智能相关、具有「道德约束力」的文件，称其「某种程度上像是一部宪法」；政府正考虑成立约10人的AI监督委员会；特朗普还宣布已正式将「人工智能」改名为「超级智能」（Super Intelligence/SI）。
updates.what_changed_en: Trump signed a 'morally binding' AI-related document with leading tech executives, calling it 'somewhat like a constitution'; the government is considering an approximately 10-person AI oversight committee; Trump also announced he had officially renamed 'Artificial Intelligence' as 'Super Intelligence' (SI).
updates.current_state_zh: 特朗普与Meta、Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Palantir、Nvidia等科技公司高管会面讨论AI治理，并签署了一份具有「道德约束力」的AI文件；政府正考虑成立约10人的AI监督委员会；特朗普宣布将AI改名为「超级智能」（SI）。
updates.current_state_en: Trump met with executives from Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Palantir and Nvidia to discuss AI governance and signed a 'morally binding' AI document; the government is considering an approximately 10-person AI oversight committee; Trump announced renaming AI as 'Super Intelligence' (SI).
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Trump signed a 'morally binding' AI document with leading tech executives, said a roughly 10-person oversight committee is under consideration, and announced he had renamed AI as 'Super Intelligence' (SI).
updates.detailed_summary_en: Trump signed a 'morally binding' AI document with leading tech executives, said a roughly 10-person oversight committee is under consideration, and announced he had renamed AI as 'Super Intelligence' (SI).
